question: At the __________, Neeraj Chopra became the first Indian to win a gold medal in javelin throw.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asian Games, 2018**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal in the **men's javelin throw** at the **2018 Asian Games** held in Jakarta, Indonesia.
 
• He achieved this feat on **August 27, 2018**, with a record throw of **88.06 meters**.
 
• Neeraj became the first Indian to win a gold medal in javelin throw in the history of the Asian Games.
 
• This performance marked him as one of India’s most promising track and field athletes on the global stage.
 
• His gold medal at the Asian Games was a precursor to his historic gold medal at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** in javelin throw.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Games:**

 
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The event is organized by the **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA)** and is recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• The 2018 Asian Games were co-hosted by the cities of Jakarta and Palembang in Indonesia.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra's Achievements:**
 
 
• Neeraj Chopra is an Indian track and field athlete who specializes in the javelin throw.
 
• He became the **second Indian athlete to win an individual Olympic gold medal** at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
 
• He is also the first Indian track and field athlete to win a gold medal at the World Athletics Championships (2023).
 
 
 
• **Javelin Throw:**
 
 
• Javelin throw is a track and field event where the athlete throws a spear-like implement called a javelin as far as possible.
 
• The sport requires a combination of strength, technique, and speed to achieve maximum distance.
 
• The javelin used in competitions weighs approximately 800 grams for men and 600 grams for women.
 
 
 
• **India's Performance in Athletics:**
 
 
• India has seen significant growth in athletics, with athletes like Neeraj Chopra, Hima Das, and others making their mark internationally.
 
• India's performance in track and field events has improved significantly in recent years, with a focus on better training, facilities, and coaching.
